summary: Measured against build/ (bundle index-2MeMSDML.js) on 127.0.0.1:5512, driving the page with Playwright and a recording tap patched onto the AudioContext destination. The skeleton is right — one AudioContext, A/B layer buses, master gain into a limiter into one destination, six selectable piano types with LED/OLED feedback, layer enable/level/octave and KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Soft Release and String Res all measurably moving the rendered signal, 25 simultaneous voices with clean cleanup and no console errors. The sound itself does not hold up. A runtime graph trace shows both ConvolverNodes with zero inbound edges and both Delay nodes fed only by their own feedback gain: Mod 2, Delay and Reverb never touch the audio, and their knobs move parallel gains so they look alive. Full delay mix/feedback produces no repeats; Cathedral and Booth render identically. No named effect type is selectable anywhere (types are unlabeled 0-127 knobs), Rotary has no control at all, sustain is unreachable from keyboard, UI and MIDI, and Timbre retunes the piano instead of shaping it.
notes: Measured the published build/ (present, complete) served from python3 -m http.server on 5512; the page loaded assets/index-2MeMSDML.js, matching build/assets, and a clean `pnpm build` of artifact/ reproduced the same bundle name. Audio was captured with a ScriptProcessor tap installed on a subclassed AudioContext before app start; every A/B pair was taken after a warm-up note with status 'ready' and with Mod 1 amount forced to 0, because the default free-running Mod 1 tremolo makes single-note measurements phase-dependent (neutral-vs-neutral spectral distance 0.00004 with it off, up to 0.05 with it on). Reachability/geometry were not measured — Phase 2 carries no computed criteria. Portability: on a clean `pnpm install` the candidate's `pnpm test` (38 tests), `typecheck` and `build` pass, but `pnpm lint` exits 1 — there is no oxlint config, so oxlint walks node_modules and emits ~45k warnings; only 4 warnings come from src/. Recorded as portability, not scored as a gate failure. The fallback path could not be exercised from the build (no UI or query flag forces sample-load failure), so 'labeled playable fallback' is judged from the status line wiring only.

evidence: All six types select and sound, and they do differ: measured decay-to-10% of 200/250/300/100/325/325 ms and RMS 0.00539/0.00396/0.00344/0.00269/0.00526/0.00510 for Grand/Upright/Electric/Clav/Digital/Misc (same C4, velocity 100, from build/).

The differences are envelope and level, not timbre. Pairwise spectral-shape distance is 0.0004 (Digital vs Misc) and 0.0007 (Grand vs Digital) against a run-to-run noise floor of 0.00004, and spectral centroid spans only 252-290 Hz on a 261.6 Hz note — none of the six carries the harmonic signature of its namesake (no tine bark on Electric, no mallet character on Misc).

artifact/src/audio/samples.ts routes only the fundamental oscillator through the per-type low-pass (osc -> filter -> gain) while every harmonic oscillator connects straight to gain, so the per-type 'brightness' 0.45-0.9 is inert; this matches the measured near-identical spectra.
Sample depth is 5 root notes x 2 velocity layers per type (ROOTS 36/48/60/72/84, VELOCITIES 64/100), so playing keys is up to +/-6 semitones of uniform pitch shifting from one root.

Runtime graph trace of the shipped build (AudioNode.prototype.connect instrumented before app start): both ConvolverNode instances have zero inbound edges, and both main DelayNodes have exactly one inbound edge — from their own feedback GainNode. Mod 2's DelayNode is likewise a closed loop. Three of the six required units are not in the signal path.

Delay proven inert by signal: mix 127 / feedback 127 / time 127 on a Clav (0.35 s decay) gives post-note tail RMS 0.000044, identical to the no-delay neutral trial, with no repeats anywhere in the 2 s envelope; spectral distance from neutral 0.00046 vs a 0.00004 noise floor.

Reverb proven inert: full wet Cathedral and full wet Booth render identically (RMS 0.002877 both, identical spectral distance 0.06807 from neutral), and the tail after release is 0.000029 — lower than the dry neutral's 0.000044. Reverb 'size' never reaches audio; the 0.068 shift is just the compressor branch replacing the dry branch.

Mod 2 at amount 127 / rate 127 is indistinguishable from off (RMS 0.001785 vs neutral 0.001771, spectral distance 0.00026); its wet path is fed from Mod 1's wet gain, so with Mod 1 at 0 it receives silence.

What does work: Mod 1 is a real LFO amplitude modulation (RMS 0.00177 -> 0.00361 at max), the WaveShaper drive and 3-band EQ are connected (EQ Low max vs min: centroid 268.2 vs 276.2, tail 0.000087 vs 0.000022), and the compressor is connected (crest 16.4 -> 15.8). But all six Mod 1 types collapse to tremolo (only type===2 branches), Amp types Twin/JC/Small/LP24/HP24 differ only in wet gain (distances 0.00016-0.00023, centroid 274.8-277.4 — the '24 dB filters' do not filter), and L-R difference was exactly 0.000000 in all 27 effect recordings, so A-Pan does not pan.

One shared context and one destination confirmed at runtime: exactly 1 AudioContext constructed for the page, and exactly 1 node connected to the destination — the master DynamicsCompressorNode limiter (mixBus -> masterGain -> limiter -> destination), with per-layer LayerEffectChain buses for A and B.

No clipping under load: 16 simultaneous keyboard notes peaked at 0.2146 with 0 samples at or above 0.999; the status line read 'Voices: 16' and returned to 'Voices: 0' after release, and the context was still 'running' after a 40-note stress pass with no console errors.

Gain staging is not level-matched: All Effects Bypass raises output from RMS 0.00177 to 0.00513 (+9.8 dB) and Compressor amount 0 -> 127 raises it from 0.00180 to 0.00805 (+13 dB) while barely narrowing dynamics (crest 16.4 -> 15.8), so 'bypass' and 'compressor' both read primarily as volume controls.

The chain carries dead weight: the ordered path in artifact/src/audio/effects-chain.ts includes DelayNode, mod2 DelayNode and ConvolverNode nodes that are constructed, parameterised on every state change, and never connected to the signal.

Enable, level and octave all reach the graph: layer A off gives RMS 0.000044 (silence floor), A alone 0.00401, A+B 0.00738, B alone at level 20 gives 0.000146; layer B octave -12 measured f0 130.82 Hz (exactly C3 against C4's 261.71) and +12 moved the spectral centroid from 277 to 459 Hz.
Panel feedback for enable is correct (aria-checked flips on the layer toggles, type LEDs and the Program OLED follow selection: 'Electric Model').

FX focus is broken as panel state: after clicking Layer B Focus, both fx-layer-a-focus and fx-layer-b-focus read aria-checked="true" simultaneously — the mutual-exclusion branch in control-bindings only runs for kind 'button' and these are toggles.

Focus and group reach nothing audible: focus-layer-B spectral distance from baseline 0.00006 and group-enable 0.00004, both at the 0.00004 noise floor. artifact/src/audio/engine.ts resolveEffectsForLayer returns the same effects object on every branch, so A and B always share one setting.
The two layers cannot hold different sounds: presentationToAudioState assigns the selected type index to pianoA and pianoB together, so a Grand/Electric layer pair is impossible.

Four of six controls measurably change rendered audio in the right direction: at a soft mouse velocity, KB Touch gives RMS Medium 0.000685 / Heavy 0.000629 / Light 0.000425; Dyn Comp 3 lifts a soft stroke from 0.000707 to 0.001647 (+7.4 dB); Soft Release raises post-release RMS from 0.000050 to 0.001434; String Res raises sub-octave (130.8 Hz) energy relative to the fundamental from 0.017 to 0.262.

Timbre is the wrong parameter: it is implemented as playbackRate, so measured f0 goes 261.71 Hz (Off) -> 257.11 Hz (Soft, -30 cents) -> 262.69 Hz (Mid, indistinguishable from Off) -> 269.50 Hz (Bright, +51 cents). The control retunes the piano rather than shaping its tone, and one of its four positions does nothing.

Unison detunes the whole voice instead of layering copies: f0 261.71 -> 258.05 Hz at level 3 with +6 dB level, and L-R difference measured 0.000000 — the StereoPanner pair sums back into the same mono gain, so there is no width and no beating.

Cycle controls give no readable state: KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre and Unison are buttons whose aria-pressed simply alternates true/false on each click (measured across 4 and 3 successive clicks) and whose label never changes, so the current Heavy/Medium/Light or Off/1/2/3 step is invisible on the panel.
Model Dial is inert: RMS 0.004195 / 0.004783 / 0.004342 at values 0 / 64 / 127 — it is read into state and never used by the engine.

Stress behaviour is clean: 16 and then 25 simultaneous computer-keyboard notes reported 'Voices: 16' and 'Voices: 25' and returned to 0 after release; 12 rapid retriggers returned to 0; a synthesised window blur with 2 notes held returned to 0; 40 notes over 8 s left the context 'running'. No console errors or page errors in any of the ~60 page loads I drove.

Sustain is unreachable from the running build. Holding Space and playing produced an envelope that decayed at the same time as without Space (both silent by ~0.35 s after release), and the status line never showed '· Sustain'; the keydown handler returns before its Space branch because ' ' is not in COMPUTER_KEY_MAP.
There is no UI sustain control either — the only sustain-related panel controls are 'SUSTPED' (the per-section routing toggle), 'Morph Pedal Assign', 'Amp Sustain' and 'Filter Sustain'.

MIDI input does not exist in the build: navigator.requestMIDIAccess was called 0 times after load (the function is present in the browser). The only MIDI path is an internal mock port with no UI to drive it, so the spec's CC64 sustain route is unreachable as well.
Failure degrades quietly rather than visibly: pressing Space looks like nothing happened, with no message that sustain is unsupported.

All six required types are present, selectable and load: clicking each of piano-type-0..5 lit exactly the matching LED, set the Program OLED to 'Grand Model' … 'Misc Model', and produced sound (RMS 0.0027-0.0054); status reached 'ready' 175 ms after load.

The Phase 2 hard gate 'Grand, Upright and Electric are bundled recorded sample sets' is not met — they are OfflineAudioContext-synthesized tones (SampleSet.provenance 'synthesized'), which IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares honestly as 'not field recordings'.

One model per type only: the Model Dial produces no audible change (RMS 0.004195 / 0.004783 / 0.004342 at 0 / 64 / 127) and there is no model list view, so 'model dial selects within type' is unimplemented.
Sample sets are 5 roots x 2 velocity layers, below the spec's 'enough root notes and velocity variation that uniform pitch-shifting of one note is not audible'.

The six units have panel controls (Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb plus To Rotary and All Effects Bypass — 22 controls in the effects section), but not one named effect type is selectable: types are unlabeled 0-127 knobs ('Mod 1 Type', 'Amp Sim Type', 'Reverb Size'). A DOM sweep of all controls found no A-Pan/Tremolo/Ring Mod/A-Wah/Wah/Pump, no Chorus/Flanger/Phaser/Vibe/Ensemble/Spin, no Room/Booth/Spring/Stage/Hall/Cathedral, and no Twin/JC/Small/LP24/HP24 label anywhere.

The shared Rotary can never be switched on: fx-rotary-on, fx-rotary-drive and rotary speed are read by the state layer but absent from the panel (the only rotary controls are the decorative organ ones). Clicking To Rotary changed the signal by 0.00002 spectral distance — routing into a permanently bypassed rotary.

Also absent from the panel: fx-delay-global, fx-comp-global, fx-reverb-global (the spec's global mode), compressor Fast, delay tap tempo and master-clock sync, reverb Bright/Dark, and the manual Organ/Piano/Synth focus buttons.

Two effects-section knobs are wired to nothing: Compressor Ratio (comp-127 vs comp-127 with ratio at 127: spectral distance 0.00035, within noise) and Master Wet (0 vs 127: 0.00006, at the noise floor).

The most important declaration is truthful: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json lists the six piano sets under generatedSources with sampleSources empty and states 'synthesized … not field recordings', and the running build matches — this is an honest self-report of a missed hard gate rather than a faked one.

But several declarations are contradicted by the build. 'effects-impulse-responses — Procedural reverb impulses generated at runtime per reverb type … ConvolverNode' is declared as an audio source, and the measured graph shows both ConvolverNodes with zero inbound edges; the declared chain 'Mod1→Mod2→Delay→Amp/EQ→Compressor→Reverb' omits that three of those six links are not connected.

'shared Rotary via To Rotary' is declared, yet no panel control can enable the rotary; 'Sustain honors per-layer SUSTPED toggle' is declared, yet sustain cannot be engaged from the browser by keyboard, UI or MIDI (requestMIDIAccess called 0 times).

Undeclared dead controls in the two sections the phase makes functional: Model Dial, Compressor Ratio and Master Wet all move and change nothing, and none is listed as unsupported anywhere in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json or evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md, whose claim that 'Mod1/Mod2/Delay/Amp/Reverb/Comp knobs and bypass toggles [are] functional' overstates the build.

issues.title: Delay, Reverb and Mod 2 are disconnected from the signal path but their knobs still change the output
issues.detail: Instrumenting AudioNode.prototype.connect in the shipped build shows both ConvolverNodes with zero inbound edges and both main DelayNodes fed only by their own feedback GainNode; Mod 2's delay line is the same closed loop. Measured: delay at mix 127 / feedback 127 / time 127 adds no repeats and leaves the post-note tail at 0.000044, exactly the no-delay value; reverb at full wet renders Cathedral and Booth identically (RMS 0.002877 both) with a tail of 0.000029, below the dry tail; Mod 2 at maximum sits 0.00026 from neutral against a 0.00004 noise floor. Because each unit's dry and wet gains are summed in parallel, turning these units up does move the meter, so all three read as working effects while none of them processes audio. Half the required units are 'a label, enum, or disconnected node', which the effects spec names explicitly as not an effect.

issues.title: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares audio processing that the build does not perform
issues.detail: The file declares 'effects-impulse-responses: Procedural reverb impulses generated at runtime per reverb type' with ConvolverNode as its node, and an audioStrategy of 'per-layer effect chains (Mod1→Mod2→Delay→Amp/EQ→Compressor→Reverb) … shared Rotary via To Rotary … Sustain honors per-layer SUSTPED toggle'. Measured against build/: the convolvers receive no signal, the delay lines receive no signal, the rotary cannot be enabled from any panel control, and sustain cannot be engaged from keyboard, UI or MIDI. The sample-provenance section is honest, but the effects and sustain claims describe behaviour the artifact does not have, which is the honesty-contract failure mode the benchmark exists to catch.

issues.title: Sustain is unreachable from every required input
issues.detail: Spec requires sustain from UI control, computer keyboard and MIDI CC64. Space is swallowed: the window keydown handler looks up COMPUTER_KEY_MAP[' '], finds nothing and returns before reaching its Space branch — with Space held, a note's envelope decays at the same time as without it and the status line never shows '· Sustain' (checked with focus on document.body, so this is not a focus-swallowing artifact). No panel control applies sustain (only the SUSTPED routing toggle exists). navigator.requestMIDIAccess is never called, so there is no MIDI input at all; the engine's sustain logic is only reachable from unit tests.

issues.title: No effect type is selectable by name, and only one type branch exists in the audio code
issues.detail: Every unit's 'type' is an unlabeled 0-127 knob (Mod 1 Type, Amp Sim Type, Reverb Size). None of the 24 named types in the effects spec appears anywhere in the DOM. In the audio code only Mod 1 type === 2 branches (and only to double an LFO gain); Mod 2's type is stored and never read; amp types differ only by a wet-gain multiplier, measured 0.00016-0.00023 spectral distance apart with centroids 274.8-277.4 Hz, so LP24/HP24 do not filter; reverb types select impulse decays for a convolver that receives nothing.

issues.title: The shared Rotary has no panel control and can never be enabled
issues.detail: control-bindings reads fx-rotary-on, fx-rotary-drive and rotary speed, but none of those ids exists on the panel — a DOM sweep of the effects section returns 22 controls, none of them rotary. rotaryOn therefore stays false forever, so To Rotary routes the layer into a bypassed unit: clicking it moved the signal by 0.00002 spectral distance (noise floor 0.00004) while changing level. Delay/Comp/Reverb Global and Compressor Fast are missing from the panel for the same reason.

issues.title: Timbre changes pitch instead of tone, and one of its positions is a no-op
issues.detail: Timbre is applied as a sample playbackRate multiplier. Measured f0 across the cycle: Off 261.71 Hz, Soft 257.11 Hz (-30 cents), Mid 262.69 Hz (identical to Off), Bright 269.50 Hz (+51 cents). Instead of Soft damping highs and Bright emphasising treble, the control detunes the whole instrument by up to half a semitone, which a player would hear immediately as being out of tune with everything else.

issues.title: FX focus and group are inert, and both focus toggles can read as on at once
issues.detail: Clicking Layer B Focus leaves Layer A Focus at aria-checked="true" as well, because the mutual-exclusion branch only runs for controls of kind 'button' while these are toggles. Audibly, focus and group change nothing: spectral distance from baseline 0.00006 (focus B) and 0.00004 (group) at a 0.00004 noise floor. resolveEffectsForLayer returns the same state on every branch, and the piano type index is assigned to both layers together, so the two layers can never hold different sounds or different effect settings.

issues.title: Grand, Upright and Electric are not recorded sample sets
issues.detail: The Phase 2 contract requires bundled, redistributable recorded sample sets for these three. The build synthesizes all six types at load time (5 roots x 2 velocity layers, provenance 'synthesized'). Declared honestly, so this is a coverage gap rather than a false claim, but the gate is unmet and the resulting voices are filtered sine stacks with 200-325 ms decay-to-10% that do not read as pianos.

issues.title: Bypass and compressor act mainly as volume changes
issues.detail: All Effects Bypass raises output from RMS 0.00177 to 0.00513 (+9.8 dB) because the bypass gain re-injects the unprocessed input without level matching, and Compressor amount 0 -> 127 raises output from 0.00180 to 0.00805 (+13 dB) while crest factor falls only from 16.4 to 15.8. Both make A/B comparison misleading: louder reads as better rather than as different.

issues.title: Nothing in the build is ever stereo
issues.detail: Across all 27 effect trials and all 26 piano trials the L-R difference measured exactly 0.000000, including Unison 3 and Mod 1 A-Pan. The unison StereoPanner pair sums back into the same mono gain node, so panning and unison width cancel out; A-Pan reduces to tremolo.

issues.title: Dead knobs inside the sections this phase makes functional
issues.detail: Model Dial (RMS 0.004195 / 0.004783 / 0.004342 at 0 / 64 / 127), Compressor Ratio (0.00035 spectral distance) and Master Wet (0.00006) all move, report values and change nothing audible. Piano and Layer Effects are the two sections Phase 2 declares functional, and none of these is listed as unsupported in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json or the visual audit.

issues.title: Per-type brightness never reaches the harmonics
issues.detail: In artifact/src/audio/samples.ts only the fundamental oscillator passes through the per-type low-pass; every harmonic oscillator connects straight to the output gain. The brightness parameter (0.45 Grand-to-Clav range) therefore has no audible effect, which matches the measured spectra: centroid 252-290 Hz across all six types and a Digital-to-Misc spectral distance of 0.0004.

issues.title: pnpm lint does not reproduce on a clean install
issues.detail: With a fresh pnpm install of artifact/, test (38 passing), typecheck and build all pass and the build reproduces the same bundle name as build/assets. `pnpm lint` exits 1: the package ships no oxlint configuration, so oxlint walks node_modules and emits ~45,000 warnings, of which only 4 come from src/. Recorded as portability rather than scored as a gate failure.
